front.title: Multicast Delivery and Endpoint Discovery for Media over QUIC

abstract.t: This document specifies multicast delivery mechanisms and catalog- based endpoint discovery for Media over QUIC (MoQ). It defines how MoQ sessions integrate with IP multicast (SSM, ASM), Automatic Multicast Tunneling (AMT), and TreeDN for scalable live streaming. The specification includes a multicast catalog extension for endpoint discovery and multi-path delivery across TV, mobile, and browser platforms. All multicast media delivery uses MPEG Media Transport Protocol (MMTP) packets, the same packet format that MoQ objects carry on QUIC streams. A manifest-based content-authentication profile protects multicast delivery with signed manifest records that travel in band beside those packets.
